name: Amazon Cognito (AWS SDK v3)
solves: Provides the AWS SDK v3 client for Amazon Cognito User Pools (`@aws-sdk/client-cognito-identity-provider`) — managed sign-up/sign-in, MFA, and federated IdP operations callable from Node.js backends in the AWS ecosystem.
best_for: AWS-centric backends that administer Cognito User Pools via the official SDK v3 client
Lambda and API Gateway stacks that need Cognito Admin* and auth APIs under IAM
Enterprises standardized on Cognito user pools for compliance and AWS Organizations controls
Services that federate enterprise IdPs into Cognito-backed APIs
Teams that prefer pay-as-you-go AWS identity over a separate auth SaaS vendor
skip_when: You want pre-built auth UI and user-admin dashboards without building Cognito Hosted UI or custom screens
You are not on AWS and do not want Cognito/IAM coupling
You need the simplest Next.js auth setup — Cognito pool config, app clients, and SDK surface area are heavy
You prefer open-source self-hosted Auth.js or Better Auth on your own database
You primarily need browser/mobile Amplify Auth helpers rather than the low-level Identity Provider client
